name: Minami Mai
source:
Hobbies: Cooking (especially making sweets)
Skills: [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mental_abacus]Mental abacus[/url]
Likes: Sweets, reading
Dislikes: Machines that are difficult to operate

The protagonist's classmate who is also the poster girl of the long-run Japanese confectionary "Minamiya". She is a rare case nowadays: a yamato nadeshiko. She is very kind and always ready to help people out, not to mention a bit naive. Good at both studying and exercising, she is, by her own words, "jack-of-all-trades and master of none".
